WITH filtered_movies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword = '10,000-mile-club'
),
filtered_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ml.movie_id, ml.linked_movie_id, ml.link_type_id
    FROM movie_link AS ml
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM filtered_movies AS fm
        WHERE fm.movie_id = ml.movie_id
    )
),
filtered_link_types AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id, lt.link
    FROM link_type AS lt
    JOIN filtered_links AS fl ON fl.link_type_id = lt.id
)
SELECT MIN(lt.link) AS link_type,
       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,
       MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM filtered_movies AS fm
JOIN title AS t1 ON t1.id = fm.movie_id
JOIN filtered_links AS fl ON fl.movie_id = t1.id
JOIN title AS t2 ON t2.id = fl.linked_movie_id
JOIN filtered_link_types AS lt ON lt.id = fl.link_type_id
